name: Kitten Philia
source:
For as long as he could remember, Yuuma was like a slave at the tailor shop.

"Go do fundraising. If you don't there'll be no dinner."

The owner of the shop, a woman masked and kitten-eared, issued demands from up on her high horse.

"I want that thing you're wearing. Take it off and place it there." 

It was beyond reasonable, yet Yuuma bent quietly to his neko mistress. This was the "world of cats", where humans daren't disobey. They were not equals here; they were far beneath the ruling cats, who do as they please.

translation:
从他记事起，游马就像裁缝店里的奴隶一样。

“去筹款吧，不然晚饭就不吃了。”

店主是一位戴着面具、长着小耳朵的女人，高高在上地发出了要求。

“我想要你穿的那个东西。把它脱下来放在那儿。” 

这实在是太不合理了，但游马却静静地向他的猫女主人弯下腰。这里是人类不敢违抗的“猫的世界”。他们在这里不平等。他们远远低于那些为所欲为的统治猫。
